title: Who’s News: Strategic Appointments at D-Wave, BTQ Technologies, Symmatrics, and Rigetti Computing - Quantum Computing Report
gist: A personnel roundup covering four quantum-sector companies: D-Wave added Carbon Robotics CFO Kevan P. Krysler to its board and audit committee, BTQ Technologies hired security veteran Dr. Michael Grace for its Quantum Compute-in-Memory program, Symmatrics named a growth SVP and a federal-sector VP, and Rigetti created a Systems Delivery organization while promoting David Rivas to COO and Andrew Bestwick to CTO. The common thread is hiring weighted toward finance/governance, commercialization, and manufacturing delivery rather than pure research.

insights.claim: D-Wave Quantum Inc. appointed Kevan P. Krysler, currently Chief Financial Officer of Carbon Robotics, to its Board of Directors and Audit Committee.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Adding a sitting CFO with public-company accounting background to the audit committee signals a company preparing its financial controls for larger-scale commercial operations.
insights.locator: D-Wave Quantum Inc. has appointed Kevan

insights.claim: Kevan P. Krysler brings over two decades of financial leadership, including roles as Chief Financial Officer of Everpure, Inc. and Senior Vice President of Finance and Chief Accounting Officer at VMware, Inc.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Enterprise-software finance experience suggests the board is being staffed for revenue-scale reporting rather than R&D-stage stewardship.
insights.locator: Krysler currently serves as Chief Financial Officer

insights.claim: The board appointment is framed as supporting growth and governance as the company scales commercial adoption of both annealing and gate-model quantum technologies.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Confirms a dual-modality product strategy — annealing plus gate-model — rather than a single-architecture bet.
insights.quote: His appointment supports D-Wave’s strategic growth objectives and corporate governance as the company scales its commercial adoption of annealing and gate-model quantum technologies.
insights.locator: His appointment supports D-Wave’s strategic growth

insights.claim: BTQ Technologies Corp. appointed Dr. Michael Grace — previously leader of the Knox Security Team at Samsung and Director of Product Security at Mojo Vision — to its U.S. technical team to support development and commercialization of its Quantum Compute-in-Memory (QCIM) architecture.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Hiring a consumer-device product-security leader points at productization and secure-hardware positioning, not just architecture research.
insights.locator: BTQ Technologies Corp. has appointed Dr. Michael Grace

insights.claim: BTQ's QCIM core has moved into module-level integration and validation after functional verification of its 28-nanometre design environment was completed alongside the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI).
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A named process node and an ITRI partnership are concrete, checkable progress markers on a semiconductor roadmap — useful milestones for tracking execution.
insights.quote: following successful functional verification of its 28-nanometre design environment alongside the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI)
insights.locator: His appointment coincides with the advancement

themes.theme: Symmatrics commercial and federal go-to-market build-out

insights.claim: Symmatrics named Jim Garrity Senior Vice President of Growth to run commercial expansion, strategic partnerships, and go-to-market strategy for its one-time pad symmetric key delivery platform.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A channel-sales hire indicates the symmetric-key product is being pushed toward distribution and partner-led revenue rather than direct pilots alone.
insights.quote: Garrity brings over 30 years of channel and sales leadership experience, having previously held senior roles at MoreDirect, VMware, Citrix, and Insight.
insights.locator: The company has named Jim Garrity

insights.claim: Symmatrics also appointed Joe Reddix, former president of The Reddix Group with project management leadership roles at General Dynamics and BAE Systems, as Vice President of Federal Sector to lead federal growth strategy and pilot deployments across government agencies.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Defense-contractor pedigree hired specifically for federal pilots suggests government agencies are the intended first revenue pool for quantum-safe key delivery.
insights.locator: Additionally, Symmatrics has appointed Joe Reddix

insights.claim: Rigetti Computing, Inc. created a dedicated Systems Delivery organization covering manufacturing operations, system installations, and commercial functions, and consolidated hardware engineering under its technology unit.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Separating delivery/manufacturing from engineering is the organizational move a hardware company makes when shipping systems to customers becomes the bottleneck rather than building them.
insights.quote: Rigetti Computing, Inc. has established a dedicated Systems Delivery organization to manage manufacturing operations, system installations, and commercial functions, while consolidating hardware engineering under its technology unit.
insights.locator: Rigetti Computing, Inc. has established a dedicated

insights.claim: As part of that restructuring, David Rivas, Chief Technology Officer since February 2023, moved into the newly created role of Chief Operating Officer, while Dr. Andrew Bestwick, previously Senior Vice President of Quantum Systems, became Chief Technology Officer overseeing quantum processor architecture and chip development.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Creating a COO seat and handing the CTO role to a quantum-systems specialist splits operational scale-up from chip roadmap ownership — a structure aimed at repeatable system shipments.
insights.locator: In connection with this operational restructuring
